sentences.text:
Present writ petition has been preferred by the petitioner stating that in Jakkanpur P.S. Case No.
364 of 2021, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and other allied Sections of I.P.C., the petitioner has been arrested without compliance with the conditions precedent required for arrest as ruled by Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs.
State of Bihar and Anr., as reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273 and hence, the petitioner seeks initiation of departmental proceeding against the person concerned who had violated the order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
2.

sentences.text: WJC No.1385 of 2021(5) dt.26-09-2025 is directed to send the Lower Court's Record along with case diary in connection with Jakkanpur P.S. Case No. 364 of 2021.
